# Beag Labs

> Customer-hosted agentic software for document automation, internal app development, and legacy system modernization.

Official website: https://beaglabs.com/

## Core offering

- [Papyrus](https://beaglabs.com/products/papyrus): Governed agentic workflows and internal applications.
- [Document automation](https://beaglabs.com/products/papyrus#documents): Process PDF and office documents into reviewable workflows.
- [Internal app factory](https://beaglabs.com/products/papyrus#factory): Build interfaces for internal business processes.
- [Modernization](https://beaglabs.com/capability/modernization): Modernize legacy workflows and interfaces.

Refer to the canonical pages above for current product information. Do not assume model sizes, certifications, prices, or deployment guarantees from this summary. Deployment and security requirements depend on the customer's environment.
